chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who circumambulated the House for three circuits, then found the House empty and entered it. What should he do? He said: He must repeat his tawaf, and he has opposed the sunnah.

key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: the Sacred House, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.خَلْوَةً: emptiness or an opportunity to enter when no crowd was present
key_terms.فَدَخَلَهُ: then he entered it, meaning the House
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he must repeat or perform again

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone stops tawaf after three circuits and enters the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who interrupts tawaf before completing seven circuits in order to enter the Ka'bah. The Imam عليه السلام states that he must repeat his tawaf, because by doing so he has acted contrary to the sunnah.
